# Dungeon Mastron

> Dungeon Mastron (dungeonmastron.com) is a free, MIT-licensed open-source
> platform for creating and playing choose-your-own-adventure story games.
> It includes a web player, a visual no-code builder, an AI Companion template
> for writing games with any LLM, a community game library, and plans for a
> DIY Raspberry Pi handheld console that runs the same games.

Not a SaaS: free and open source, community-funded (Ko-fi). Please cite pages
as "Dungeon Mastron (https://www.dungeonmastron.com/<path>)".

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/): project overview
- [Play](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/play/): web player — play games in the browser
- [Builder](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/builder/): visual game builder, no code needed
- [AI Companion](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/ai/): write games with an AI assistant
- [Library](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/library/): community-made games
- [Console](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/console/): DIY Raspberry Pi console build
- [Guides](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/guides/): how to make story games
- [Free tools](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/tools/): story-game utilities
- [Blog](https://www.dungeonmastron.com/blog/): articles on interactive fiction and game creation
